Michael Moritz joins Patrick O’Shaughnessy for a wide-ranging conversation about the forces that shape exceptional people. Moritz reflects on growing up in a family of Jewish refugees from Nazi Germany, the outsider mentality that followed him throughout his life, and why he spent so much time studying the childhoods and backgrounds of founders. He shares the questions he used to understand people, what he learned from decades around extraordinary leaders, and why complete obsession often comes with a cost.
